settings.heading: Why Arista Laminate?
settings.content: The Arista Laminate Collection delivers durability and style at an unbeatable value. Featuring oversized planks, ultra-realistic textures, and a superior AC5 scratch rating, it’s built to handle daily life while bringing the beauty of a natural wood look to your space. Arista features a water resistant core and a pre-attached underlayment for quieter steps. With effortless click installation, Arista offers high-end design without the high-maintenance hassle.

settings.heading: Sustainable Style. Exceptional Durability.
settings.content:
When you experience Arista Laminate, you’ll instantly recognize what sets it apart. Built to withstand the demands of everyday life while maintaining stunning aesthetics, Arista is a resilient, go-anywhere floor that also delivers a premium wood look. The Arista Collection offers a variety of stunning colors, each with oversized planks, ultra-realistic textures, and a robust AC5 scratch rating.

Easy Installation: Arista features a Uniclic locking mechanism and a floating installation for a fast and simple installation.

Superior Scratch-Resistance: Built with an AC5 scratch rating, Arista is tough enough to handle high-traffic areas without compromising its beauty.

Exceptional Value: Offering premium laminate performance at an affordable price, Arista brings high-end design within reach.

settings.accordion_title: What environmental certifications does Arista have?
settings.accordion_content: Arista is FloorScore Certified and CARB Compliant, ensuring low emissions and excellent indoor air quality.

settings.accordion_title: Is the arista collection scratch resistant?
settings.accordion_content: Arista boasts an AC5 rating, delivering industry-leading scratch resistance—especially against acute scratches.

We offer a full range of matching transition pieces, including T-moldings, Reducers, Nosing Rounds and Stair Pieces.

To find the transition or trim piece you need, navigate to the product page of the color you are looking for. Scroll down to the section titled “Accessories” and press the right arrow button to scroll through all the transition pieces available for that color. If you are looking for a specific piece, you can also use the search feature located on the top right corner of any page of our website.
